rationale: Correct the existing Thunderbird Renewables record in place rather than adding the duplicate ArcLight owner proposed by the census queue. The census manager label ArcLight Capital resolves to the existing canonical ArcLight Capital Partners ownership period and does not establish a second owner. ArcLight identifies Thunderbird as a current Fund VIII portfolio managed through SkyVest, while its 2025 ESG report presents Thunderbird as a 309 MW operating renewables portfolio. FERC notices and filings establish Fund VIII vehicle closings for 50% of Lakefield Wind Project on February 21, 2025, 100% of Shiloh IV on March 12, 2025, and the remaining 50% of Lakefield on July 1, 2025. Those closings support correcting the existing ownership entry year from 2024 to 2025 and replacing the unsupported 2024 milestones. SkyVest is the management platform, and Lakefield and Shiloh IV are underlying projects, so none is added as a separate owner or PortCo in this task. The project-level percentages are not stored as a manager-level Thunderbird stake. Public sources reviewed do not disclose a separate Thunderbird headquarters, legal suffix, website, founding year or manager-level ownership percentage. No Thunderbird-level sale, completed exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Thunderbird Renewables is an ArcLight Infrastructure Partners Fund VIII portfolio of operating U.S. wind-generation assets managed through ArcLight's SkyVest Renewables platform. Regulatory filings show Fund VIII vehicles acquired a 50% indirect interest in the Lakefield Wind Project on February 21, 2025 and a 100% indirect interest in the Shiloh IV Wind Project on March 12, 2025, then acquired the remaining 50% Lakefield interest on July 1, 2025. ArcLight's 2025 ESG report presents Thunderbird as a 309 MW operating renewables portfolio. Thunderbird is counted as the manager-level portfolio, while SkyVest is the management platform and Lakefield and Shiloh IV are underlying assets. ArcLight's live investments page lists Thunderbird as Current. Public sources reviewed do not disclose Thunderbird's legal suffix, separate website, founding year, headquarters or manager-level ownership percentage, and no Thunderbird-level exit or signed pending transaction was identified through August 15, 2026.

set.event: ArcLight Fund VIII's F8 Renewables vehicle acquired a 50% indirect interest in the 205.5 MW Lakefield wind facility on February 21 and a 100% indirect interest in the 102.5 MW Shiloh IV wind facility on March 12, establishing Thunderbird's initial 2025 operating portfolio.
ArcLight Fund VIII's F8 Renewables vehicle acquired TAQA's remaining 50% indirect interest in the Lakefield wind facility, taking its project-level interest to 100%.
